description: Lists the messages of one conversation, named by conversation_id (or of one contact, by contact_id), oldest first, one page at a time. With neither, it lists recent messages across the whole workspace. Message bodies include what members of the public wrote, and every one comes back marked untrusted.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

contact_id.description: Messages with one contact instead of one conversation.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

name: read_conversation
title: Read a conversation
